pairs.question: compare hobnob and readback
pairs.why: Both are clear and well structured, with similarly short sentences and scannable product s
pairs.beforeText: Hobnob: Meeting note-takers ship your conversations to someone else's server. It runs on Whisper (large-v3-turbo), Local GGUF LLMs, Live captions. Readback: Reading-comprehension programs are closed systems: the school picks the quizzes, parents never see them, and the reading log lives on someone else's server. It runs on Python 3.10+, Flask 3, Jinja (no JS).
